stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent v2.9.8 beta introduces the first transparent Smart Scoring readiness gate: for automatic APPLY, ordinary target Data/Business Analyst roles now require candidate_fit >= 10, while clearly junior/intern/trainee target roles require >= 6. A high title/overall match without sufficient skill evidence becomes REVIEW rather than automatic APPLY, and explicit user-approved REVIEW preparation remains available subject to existing safety gates. Skills readiness minimum/blockers, matched and missing skills are retained in Dashboard snapshots and logged separately from the numeric relevance score. Pending Jobs.cz PRE_APPLY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED handoffs are no longer retried by the automatic search, preserving the manual follow-up link and history. GitHub Actions: 57 tests passed; final Submit remains manual.
